statusText: Mapped policy state: WATCH. Tail remains below the 25% block threshold while Stress is extreme.
recommendation: Current evidence supports a watch state: the latest delayed NQ path remains materially two-sided, while oil, rates and geopolitical escalation keep the environment highly stressed.
headline: Large intraday NQ rebound keeps Tail below the block threshold despite extreme macro stress
body: A delayed NQ quote at 17:47 UTC showed 29,439 after trading between 29,273.50 and 29,546.25, leaving a substantial rebound from the session low and no verified persistent no-retracement path. Oil above $90, elevated Treasury yields and renewed U.S.-Iran fighting keep Stress extreme.

lookbackSummary: Over the prior 24 clock-hours, Tail moved from low readings late Sunday into event/whipsaw WATCH and brief elevated states as geopolitical and energy stress intensified. Tail peaked at 30% around 01:00 UTC, then mostly held 21-24% WATCH with a short 26% elevation at 08:00 UTC; Stress remained extreme.
outlookSummary: The next 24 hours keep Stress very high but Tail mostly in WATCH unless price structure becomes persistently one-way. The immediate danger window is the 19:00-20:00 UTC power hour. Tuesday's Barr speech at 13:05 UTC and the 14:00 UTC JOLTS/ISM Manufacturing cluster are the next major checkpoints.

forecast.analysis: A delayed NQ quote at 17:47 UTC showed 29,439 after a 29,273.50 session low and 29,546.25 high. The roughly 166-point rebound from the low confirms meaningful two-sided trade; oil, yields and U.S.-Iran escalation keep Stress extreme.

forecast.analysis: Power-hour Tail rises within WATCH because late-session flow can become directional. A sustained extension that holds near an extreme with shallow or failed retracements would be the key escalation signal; rotational trade would keep Tail below 25%.

forecast.analysis: Into and just after the cash close, Tail should ease if the closing auction is absorbed and price continues to rotate. A fresh geopolitical shock or an uncorrected directional close would keep event/whipsaw risk elevated.

forecast.analysis: Early after-hours conditions are thinner and more headline-sensitive. Without a new catalyst, the day’s large intraday reversal favors mixed structure over persistent one-way behavior, while the oil-risk premium keeps Stress high.

Later U.S. evening trade carries less cash-flow pressure. Tail remains near the low end of WATCH if futures stay rotational; a renewed oil or geopolitical jump would be a conditional reason for higher path risk.

The overnight handoff remains vulnerable to headlines but lacks an automatic directional catalyst. Two-sided trade would keep Tail contained, while any fresh gap plus poor retracement would matter more than headline importance alone.

Early Asia trade may react to the U.S. close and energy markets. Tail stays in WATCH unless a gap develops into repeated extension with little retracement; otherwise the prior session’s reversal remains the more relevant path template.

As Asian liquidity develops, persistent direction would require confirmation from both index structure and cross-assets. Absent that alignment, mixed trade remains the base condition despite elevated macro Stress.
Mid-Asia conditions carry lower scheduled-event risk. Tail can stay near 20% if pullbacks remain available and price does not hold a session extreme; geopolitical risk keeps Stress from normalizing.
Late Asian trade is expected to be more rotational unless a new catalyst emerges. A one-way move would need repeated extension and weak retracement before Tail rises materially.

The pre-Europe transition has no major scheduled U.S. release. Tail remains contained conditionally on orderly price discovery; gap persistence or aligned rates/oil pressure would be the main invalidation.
Approaching Europe, unresolved geopolitical risk keeps Stress elevated, but Tail remains at WATCH unless price structure becomes directionally efficient with shallow counter-moves.

European pre-open flow can reprice energy and rates. Tail edges higher only modestly because no directional outcome is assumed; observed gap continuation without retracement would be the relevant checkpoint.
The European cash open raises whipsaw risk. A clean continuation that survives the first retracement would raise Tail, while a normal opening reversal would preserve the mixed regime.
After the European opening burst, Tail remains in WATCH if price begins to rotate. Persistent index direction would need confirmation from yields, oil and large-cap technology participation.
Mid-morning Europe has lower scheduled U.S. event pressure. Tail can ease if NQ remains balanced and retracements are normal; renewed session-extreme holding would be the main concern.
Late European morning remains a transition phase. Without a fresh catalyst, two-sided structure keeps Tail contained; persistent oil and rate pressure continue to support elevated Stress.
As U.S. participation increases, positioning ahead of the afternoon data cluster can widen intraday swings. Tail stays in WATCH unless pre-data price action becomes persistently one-way.

The U.S. premarket hour carries higher event sensitivity ahead of Governor Barr and the 14:00 UTC data cluster. Scheduled importance raises Stress, while Tail still depends on observed price-path quality.
drivers: JOLTS and ISM Manufacturing at 14:00 UTC

forecast.analysis: Governor Barr’s 13:05 UTC speech is a live policy checkpoint. Tail remains below the block threshold unless rates and NQ align into repeated extension with shallow retracements before the 14:00 UTC releases.

JOLTS, ISM Manufacturing and Construction Spending arrive at 14:00 UTC. Stress is extreme around the release cluster; Tail reaches the top of WATCH conditionally and would require observed post-release one-way structure to move higher.

The first post-data cash hour is the main repricing window. Tail remains at 24% unless the observed move extends repeatedly, holds near an extreme and denies meaningful retracement; orderly two-sided discovery would reduce it.
After the first post-release hour, Tail should ease if volatility decays and counter-moves broaden. Persistent cross-asset alignment with renewed NQ extension would keep the regime in event/whipsaw.

By the second full cash-session hour after the data, Tail is expected to moderate if price discovery remains orderly. A delayed second leg would need fresh evidence from NQ structure rather than event importance alone.

forecastDetail.comment: Observed delayed NQ data show a wide two-sided session and a substantial rebound from the low; Tail remains WATCH despite extreme Stress.
Power-hour risk is concentrated here; sustained extreme-holding with weak retracement would be the escalation signal.
Closing-auction absorption would reduce Tail, while a directional close or fresh geopolitical shock would preserve event/whipsaw risk.
After-hours liquidity is thinner; the prior intraday reversal favors mixed structure unless a new catalyst produces one-way continuation.
Lower evening cash-flow pressure keeps Tail near the low end of WATCH, with oil and geopolitical headlines the main conditional amplifiers.
Overnight headline risk remains, but gap persistence and failed retracement—not headline importance alone—would drive higher Tail.
